maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from sample storage, multiomics/genomics services and cold-storage instruments and consumables, not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are pharma, biotech, CDMOs, research labs and IVF clinics, mostly private payers, though some academic grants fund research.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic from storage, genomics services and products; acquisitions such as UK Biocentre are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Customers' irreplaceable samples and drug products sit in GxP-compliant storage with Limfinity tracking; moving them risks integrity and requalification.
